capability-words.page.team: The order's AI team shares one tool list: every agent that works on the order's files can use each tool here, and Chausar's code refuses any other. Whatever is on, anything that sends, spends, posts or changes a price still waits for your approval.
capability-words.page.none: It holds no tools of its own: it works from what the team found. Anything that sends, spends, posts or changes a price still waits for your approval.
capability-words.tool:files.list: The list of files the client sent with the order.
capability-words.tool:files.read: The files the client sent with the order: tables, PDF text and transcript lines.
capability-words.tool:dictionary.browse: Your business dictionary: its terms, offers, steps and settings.
capability-words.input:request: The client's request on the order and the offer it is for.
capability-words.input:files: The names and kinds of the files on the order.
capability-words.input:answers: Your answers to the questions the team asked, and the client answers you passed on.
capability-words.input:notes: The notes of the agents working on the order, as background that grants nothing.
capability-words.input:knowledge: Sources from what the AI knows that share words with the order, as background. They can include work you accepted for other clients.
capability-words.input:proven: What the team's tools proved on the order, and the team's note on each step.
capability-words.input:verify: The draft, to run its checks.
capability-words.nothing: Nothing: none of its steps gives it anything to read.
capability-words.tool:handoff.client: Ask the client a question. You pass it on: nothing reaches the client without you.
capability-words.tool:handoff.owner: Ask you a question and wait for your answer.
capability-words.outbox:mail-app: Propose an email for your approval. Nothing is sent: Chausar records it, and you send it yourself from your own mail app.
capability-words.outbox:payment-link: Propose a payment link for your approval. Planned: no payment link connector is built, so the proposal is only recorded.
capability-words.model:provider: Send each step, with what it reads, to your own AI provider: your key or the CLI you set up.
capability-words.effect:send: Can't send anything to a client, a contact or the public.
capability-words.effect:money: Can't move money or ask for it.
capability-words.effect:write: Can't change your records, files or connected services.
capability-words.effect:egress: Can't take data off this computer or hand it to another program.
capability-words.cli:agent.delegate: Hand a big job to your own Claude Code or Codex on this computer, only after you approve its brief. Off here: neither Claude Code nor Codex is set up on this computer.
